info.title: xPlant API
info.description: The xPlant REST API. Every request is scoped to the calling key's workspace. Responses are `{ ok: true, data }` on success and `{ ok: false, data: null, error, code }` on failure; branch on `code`.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Who the calling key is, and the workspace it belongs to.

tags.name: Change history
tags.description: An audit trail of edits to plant and explant records, for incremental sync.

tags.name: Demand signals
tags.description: Sales and order demand per genus, used to prioritise the task queue.

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: Register devices, send heartbeats and manage device tokens.

tags.name: Equipment
tags.description: The lab equipment library and its use and maintenance history.

tags.name: Explants
tags.description: Explant and culture records, with their vessel and plantlet counts.

tags.name: Labels
tags.description: Resolve a scanned QR code or barcode to the record it identifies.

tags.name: Sensor readings
tags.description: Environmental readings such as temperature and humidity.

tags.name: SOP runs
tags.description: Run a procedure step by step and record evidence against each step.

tags.name: SOPs
tags.description: Standard operating procedures and their steps.

tags.name: Stages
tags.description: The stage history of plants and explants.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: The lab's task queue: create, schedule, prioritise, assign and complete work.

tags.name: Transfers
tags.description: Transfers of plants and explants onto fresh media.

parameters.description: Only tasks in this board column.

parameters.name: assigned_to
parameters.description: Only tasks assigned to this workspace member (user id).

post.description:
Adds a task to the workspace. Set `priority`, `priority_rank` and `assigned_to` in the same call so a scheduler can place work in one request. Order set this way counts as automatic, so a later hand-reorder in the app takes precedence over your next sync.

Link the task to the plant or explant it is about with `entity_type` and `entity_id` — send both or neither.

example.title: Transfer the Alocasia line onto fresh medium

bearerAuth.description: A workspace API key, created in xPlant under Settings → Integrations → API Keys. It carries only the scopes granted to it and acts on one workspace.

deviceToken.description: A device token, minted for one registered device. It can only post that device's sensor readings, events and heartbeat — never read lab records.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Values above 200 are capped at 200.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Any unique string you choose per logical write. A retry carrying the same key within 24 hours returns the first result instead of writing again. Scoped to your API key and this operation.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

IdempotentReplay.description: `true` when this response is a replay of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

error.description: What went wrong, for people. May be reworded.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this.

id.description: The signal's id — or `current` on the reading `current=true` returns.

assigned_to.description: User id of the workspace member the task is assigned to.

priority_rank.description: Queue position. Lower sorts first; null means the priority label decides.

priority_source.description: Where the current order came from. `manual` means a person placed the task, and automated writes leave it where it is unless they send `release: true`.

entity_link.description: The plant or explant the task is about. Returned when you create, fetch or update one task; lists leave it out.
